<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Slingshot Maneuver](/Feats.aspx?ID=5482) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 75

**Archetype** [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224)

**Prerequisites**
[Thlipit Contestant Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5474)

**Trigger**
A willing ally enters a space within your lash’s reach using a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) action.

</column>

---

You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement. You move the ally 15 feet into a square of their choice that is within reach of your lash. If the ally has movement remaining, they can continue their movement after completing the Slingshot Maneuver.
name: Slingshot Maneuver
